verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own REST API can retrieve session history for a selected time range and is described as a way to collect session logs. Its official open-source Python module can export session data to CSV, and the portal mentions monitoring sessions. However, export depends on API scripting rather than a documented in-console audit export, and the docs never list the record fields (who, which machine, when). missing for 10: documented session record fields (connecting user, target device, timestamps), a built-in portal export or audit-log feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit
